supersedes: V34 revision-1 wireless charging source, rejected because it omitted the bottom-attached physical connector
purpose: Generate only the compact bottom-connector charging animation component. It composes over the locked V9 daily face and does not generate a character face.

source_output.name: bottom_connector_charging
source_output.semantic: a compact connector seats into the underside, then one and two small energy pulses rise from that actual connection

source_gate: The generated source contains no face, body, text, label, border, UI panel, dangling cable, generic battery or lightning-only badge.
At native 200x200 composition, the bottom connector remains in the declared safe box and does not obscure daily eye, brow, nose or mouth components.
Labels hidden, the three frames read as a bottom-attached charging connection rather than a detached dock or generic happiness.
A rejected source is frozen audit-only and cannot be a visual reference, exported component, runtime binding or firmware asset.
